summary: Phase 149O.13 -- HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Independent Implementation Verification: verification-only phase, zero src/pcae/** or contract changes. Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.12C) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, 149O.12C completed/complete/pushed, HSCE-001 v1.1 unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full HSCE-001 v1.1 and HATP-001 v1.0 contracts directly (not summaries), and the complete production source of all four implementation modules (hatp_signed_evidence.py, hatp_evidence_store.py, hatp_signing_ceremony.py, commands/hatp.py, plus cli.py's registration block, human_approval_trusted_provenance.py's canonicalization/digest functions, hatp_providers.py/hatp_fido2_provider.py's credential_identity/request_signature split, and pcae.governance.publication.coordinator._parse_timestamp for the Python 3.9 defect). Independently reconstructed the production diff across 149O.12A->12C (zero unrelated hunks) and sampled contract traceability against source rather than the 149O.11 plan's own table. Authored 111 freshly-written, independently-derived tests in tests/test_phase_149o_13_hatp_signing_ceremony_evidence_store_independent_verification.py covering: exact model field set/immutability/no-authority-fields; the version-bool domain attack on both constructor and parser; the evidence-ID domain attack (uppercase/mixed-case/wrong-length/nonhex/whitespace/slash/backslash/dot-dot/Cyrillic-lookalike) on both paths; constructor/parser domain equivalence; digest-mismatch rejection on both paths; provider-assertion independence from evidence_id; canonical round-trip and non-canonical-JSON normalization; duplicate outer and nested JSON keys; unknown/missing top-level fields; base64 malformed/corrupt-but-structural attacks; store path layout and no-construction-side-effects; path traversal and absolute-path evidence-ID rejection; symlink-final-destination and symlink-store-root-escape attacks with external-target-untouched verification; directory/FIFO/unreadable-file special-object attacks against a real filesystem; single-winner/identical-retry/differing-retry publication semantics; 8-real-thread identical-writer and mixed-identical-and-differing many-writer races; simulated EXDEV non-EEXIST link failure with no-fallback confirmation; temp-file-cleanup confirmation; explicit-ID-only load API and load-does-not-verify; zero-override production-wrapper signature and CLI-call-target AST/tokenize proof; precondition-failure-touches-no-hardware for all six failure modes (including an independent finding on Binding-before-repository-identity resolution order); preview-before-touch call-order instrumentation and cancellation-touches-nothing; exactly-one-signature-attempt for both a normal ceremony and two independently-shaped TOCTOU-discard attacks (Binding revocation, and repository-identity mutation); no-authority-conflation static/dynamic checks (no permission_broker import, no verify_hatp_proof/execute_rollback/build_rollback_execution/run_rollback calls, no rollback_approval_state mutation, evidence existence does not change rollback preconditions -- with an independent finding clarifying a pre-existing, unrelated 149O.6 AG5/AG3 hook on build_rollback_execution/execute_rollback); the full 27-flag forbidden-flag inventory against both the real parser and the cli.py registration source; CLI grammar/site-case-sensitivity/locator-validation exact reproduction; help-without-hardware-touch in genuine fresh subprocesses including from a nested working directory; human/JSON output schema exactness free of any authority-claiming field; the closed 12-member error vocabulary/9-exit-category mapping and unclassified-exception-propagates-uncaught; SC-1..SC-12 security invariants individually; secret/PIN/private-key absence from persisted evidence; all 21 mandatory HSCE attacks plus the 4 extra 149O.10.1/149O.11 implementation attacks, each independently reproduced against the real, assembled implementation; and additional attacks beyond the 25 (two simultaneous signing ceremonies legitimately coexisting, forged-idempotent-interpretation rejection, nested-working-directory CLI invocation). Independently reproduced and confirmed the pre-existing Python 3.9/3.10 pcae.governance.publication.coordinator._parse_timestamp defect by direct source inspection (captured before this suite's own autouse Z-tolerance monkeypatch applies) and version-gated CPython-behavior reasoning -- no Python 3.9 interpreter was available in this environment, disclosed explicitly rather than papered over -- and traced its operational effect: it blocks *creating new* CHGR Decisions/RAE Bindings via production code on Python 3.9/3.10, which operationally blocks onboarding new operations to signing on those interpreters specifically (existing pre-created Bindings are unaffected). Assigned it the qualified identifier 149O.12B-Obs-PY39-1. Ran and reconfirmed non-regression: 149O.12A dedicated suites (132 passed), 149O.12B dedicated suite (44 passed), 149O.12C dedicated suites (188 passed), the contract-phase regression sweep (149O.9/10/10.1/10.2: 195 passed, 3 failed -- independently explained as three pre-existing byte-history 'no CLI exists yet' boundary snapshots not among 149O.12C's own six-file 149O.5-F-3 widening, now correctly false since the CLI exists; recommended for a follow-up widening, not repaired here), a full -k "hatp or rollback_approval" sweep (2112 passed, 13 failed, 3 skipped -- exactly matching 149O.12C's own documented pre-existing failure count, confirming zero new regressions since 149O.13 made zero production changes), and Fast Green (4980 passed, 2 skipped, 0 genuine failures -- a +112 delta over the 149O.12C-entering baseline of 4868, dominated by this phase's own 111 newly registered tests; one pre-existing fido2-dependency collection error excluded, unrelated). VERDICT: HSCE IMPLEMENTATION VERDICT: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HSCE-001 v1.1 SIGNING CEREMONY + EVIDENCE STORE IMPLEMENTATION CONFORMS. Zero Blocking findings; five Non-Blocking findings recorded (Binding-before-repository-identity precondition-resolution order; TOCTOU-via-revocation surfaces binding_unavailable rather than the literally-named evidence_serialization_failure, security property holds under both; build_rollback_execution/execute_rollback's pre-existing, unrelated, inert 149O.6 hook parameters clarified as distinct from 149O.12's HSCE mechanism, with the real CLI call site confirmed to pass none of them; three pre-existing boundary test files need a follow-up 149O.5-F-3-style widening; Python 3.9/3.10 timestamp defect 149O.12B-Obs-PY39-1 blocks fresh-Decision/Binding creation on those interpreters). HATP SIGNING SURFACE: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- EVIDENCE CREATION ONLY, NOT ROLLBACK AUTHORIZATION OR EXECUTION. AG3/AG5 MANDATORY HATP CONSUMPTION: NOT IMPLEMENTED. 149O.10-F-3 and 149O.10.2-Obs-3 both independently reconfirmed resolved/closed under real 8-thread concurrency and real special-file attacks. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, RAE-001 v1.0 all confirmed byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_13_HATP_SIGNING_CEREMONY_EVIDENCE_STORE_INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: HATP AG3/AG5 Mandatory Production Consumption Architecture/Contract.
